import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json,base64
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();w=str(p/'write_lane.py')
def write(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
q=['"1106.5068" "Conjecture 47" polynomial','McAllister Woods minimum period Ehrhart quasi polynomial rational polytope theorem pdf']
write('search-plan-1.json',json.dumps({'queries':q},indent=2))
print(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());print(Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text() if Path('search-charges.jsonl').exists() else 'No charges yet')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),'search-plan-1.json'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for page in [9,16,17,18]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1600','-singlefile','-png',str(p/'inputs/arrays.pdf')],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 r2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'figures/arrays-p'+str(page)+'.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),capture_output=True,text=True);assert r2.returncode==0,r2.stderr
 print('rendered',page)
